title: The reference index calls a release's surface identical to the last one when only a verb changed: neither generator compares a command's verb values, so 3.4.0's index says identical to v3.3.3 though it adds claude rules contract
body:
**THE 3.4.0 REFERENCE SAYS ITS SURFACE IS IDENTICAL TO 3.3.3, AND 3.4.0 ADDS A VERB.** Found by ic on 2026-11-17 (12:04Z by date -u) while regenerating the reference set for the 3.4.0 cut's step 2, at 6eb2ef135 against v3.3.3.

**What the page says.** `docs/reference/index.md`'s "Against the published release" section reads "The surface at `HEAD` is identical to `v3.3.3`". Issue 0700 added `intent claude rules contract`, which hv decision 60 calls new surface and which makes the release a minor.

**Why.** Neither generator compares a command's verb values, the third level of the surface (`claude rules` holds `list`, `show`, `validate` and now `contract` in its verb slot).
- `gen_reference.sh` prints "identical" when no shipped command path was added or retired (line 503). It compares neither verbs nor flags.
- `gen_cut_surface.sh` compares command paths and, in its Flags section, (command, flag) pairs. It has no Verbs section, so a verb added to a command that already ships appears nowhere in "What changed since".
- The cut surface's own comment names this blind spot for flags ("A FLAG ON AN ALREADY-SHIPPING COMMAND IS INVISIBLE TO THE DIFF ABOVE"), which is why its Flags section exists. The same holds for a verb.

**The fix (vc, 2026-11-17: built in this release).**
- One reader in `lib_surface.sh` pairs each shipped command with its verb values. The flag pairs move there beside it, so both generators read one home.
- `gen_cut_surface.sh` gains a Verbs section beside Flags.
- The index lists new verbs and says "identical" only when commands, verbs and flags all agree.

**Proof.** The regenerated 3.4.0 pages name `intent claude rules contract` in the index and in the cut surface, read in the diff, and `reference_current_check.sh` exits 0 at the bank's tree. The fix and the regenerated reference set are one bank.
